profile.description: OmniHuman, by Bytedance, generates video using an image of a human figure paired with an audio file. It produces vivid, high-quality videos where the character’s emotions and movements maintain a strong correlation with the audio. Send an image including a human figure with a visible face, and an audio, and the bot will return a video. The maximum audio length accepted is 30 seconds.
